rationale: Reviewed for the 0.3.0 release. All remaining findings are inherited through pinned upstream dependencies whose only fix is a breaking major or an unused transitive AWS SDK XML parser. fast-xml-parser 5.7.3 (low, GHSA-474x-hrwr-fgx4) is nested inside @earendil-works/pi-ai -> @aws-sdk/client-bedrock-runtime -> @aws-sdk/xml-builder, which SlideStudio does not call. glob 13.0.6 is nested in pinned @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent 0.80.10 and requires glob >=14.0.2. minimatch (GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249, advisory range >=7.0.0 <11.0.1) is required at 10.x by eslint 10.13.0 and typescript-eslint 8.72.0. image-size 1.2.1 is required by pptxgenjs 3.x (^1.2.1). zod 4 is installed at 4.6.7 outside GHSA-mrhx-c7xc-m3w5, while legacy packages keep zod 3.25.76. This exception does not accept new advisories or critical findings.
